nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.qc.hotspot_embed¶

Precompute PyVista hotspot HTML exports for QC gallery.

Functions¶

export_hotspot_gallery_for_batch(...)

For each subject and each voxelwise measure, write hotspot_<subj>_<meas>.html.

hotspot_gallery_control_html(→ str)

Two <select> elements + <iframe>; measure list depends on subject.

hotspot_gallery_control_srcdoc(→ str)

Hotspot gallery where each (subject,measure) maps to an iframe srcdoc HTML string.

Module Contents¶

nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.qc.hotspot_embed.export_hotspot_gallery_for_batch(lay, subjects: list[str], out_dir: pathlib.Path, *, rel_assets_root: str, notebook: bool = True) → tuple[list[tuple[str, str, str]], list[str]]¶

For each subject and each voxelwise measure, write hotspot_<subj>_<meas>.html.

Returns:

  • entries – (subject, measure, rel_html_path) for the parent page selectors.

  • errors – Human-readable skip messages.

nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.qc.hotspot_embed.hotspot_gallery_control_html(entries: list[tuple[str, str, str]], *, dom_prefix: str) → str¶

Two <select> elements + <iframe>; measure list depends on subject.

dom_prefix is required so CT-PET and Dixon widgets don’t collide in the same page.

nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.qc.hotspot_embed.hotspot_gallery_control_srcdoc(html_map: dict[str, dict[str, str]], *, dom_prefix: str) → str¶

Hotspot gallery where each (subject,measure) maps to an iframe srcdoc HTML string.

NOTE: raw HTML must NOT be embedded directly into JS literals (it can contain quotes and even </script>). We base64-encode values and store them in a JSON blob.
